# LagReducer

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** LagReducer

## What it does

Limits your FPS when you are not tabbed into the game

Description basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/LagReducer.html). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
